goal: Validate Tor onion service replies and cached keys to prevent command and argument injection into Tor
Stop unprivileged local processes from poisoning cached keys to issue malicious Tor commands
Prevent nodes from accepting and advertising malformed onion service addresses
agreement: Strong support for validating Tor control replies and private key handling (vasild, jeanpablojp)
Verified by building and testing on FreeBSD (winterrdog)
Minor open suggestions on local variable cleanup are noted as non-blocking (vasild)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it closes a command injection vector into the Tor daemon from spoofed or malformed replies
Prevents unprivileged local processes from poisoning the onion key cache to trigger daemon shutdown
